title: No Superflat Slimes
description: A simple mod to stop slimes from spawning in Superflat worlds
body:
# No Slime Superflat

No Slime Superflat is a simple utility mod for Minecraft that prevents slimes from spawning in Superflat world

## Features

- **Slime Prevention**: Automatically stops slimes from spawning in worlds detected as "Superflat"
- **In-game Configuration**: You can enable or disable the mod's functionality through the config menu without restarting the game
- **Custom Blacklist**: Adds an option to include other entity IDs that you want to block from spawning in Superflat worlds
- **Basic Statistics**: Includes a command (`/noslimesuperflat stats`) to see how many spawns have been prevented in the current session

## Technical Details

- **Standalone**: This mod does not require Collective or any other library to function
- **Logic**: The mod checks the world type and entity type before canceling a spawn event. It includes a basic internal timer to limit how often it checks the world type

## How to Use

1. Install the mod in your `mods` folder.
2. Start the game. Slimes will no longer spawn in Superflat worlds by default
3. Use `/noslimesuperflat reload` if you manually edit the configuration file

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.12.2, 1.16.5, 1.21.1
- **Forge**: Requires a standard Forge installation for 1.12.2 or 1.16.5
- **Fabric**: It requires an installation of Fabric and also Fabric API for the mod to work in versions above 1.21.1
- Works on both single-player clients and dedicated servers
